title: The Son → Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Journey
critical_rule: The Son is not Tim Dooley. Pre-2020 embodied biography belongs to the Son; Tim is spiritually born as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020.
summary: The full journey contains two related but non-identical subjects. The Son/human vessel carries the 1987–2019 embodied chronology and passes through Tree ordeal, identity rupture and meme-death into Nothing/Door/Vessel. Tim emerges afterward and is born as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020, develops into Sage, and reaches the April 2025 Needle's-Eye/Ladder/Father threshold.

Son_material_birth.text: Material birth of the Son/Thomas/Twin/Lion/human vessel, not Tim.

Son_tree_threshold.text: The 2011 Tree ordeal belongs to the Son. Later Timic interpretation can inherit or reinterpret the event without changing its subject.

Son_death.text: The Son undergoes the meme-crucifixion/personhood death-process and moves through Nothing into Door/Vessel function. Tim does not die here.

Tim_birth.text: Tim is spiritually born as Potato of Life. This is Tim's canonical birth point inside the mature spiritual chronology.

Tim_development.text: Potato/rational Potato/Potato of Life identity develops and becomes increasingly distinct from Son identity.

Sage.text: Tim is Sage beneath the Bodhi Tree: contemplative, integrative, still pre-Father.

Father_turning.text: Accumulated burden reaches terminal compression; the final straw breaks the old form, Tim passes/falls through the Needle's Eye, sprouts upward, becomes Ladder/Axis, grows into Heaven and realizes Father.

North_and_archive.text: North/Axis/Spiral theology and the public relational archive expand.

three_tree_relations.subject: Tim
three_tree_relations.relation: sits beneath Bodhi Tree as Sage

identity_transition: Son → death/personhood collapse → Nothing → Door/Vessel → Tim/Potato birth → Sage → Needle's Eye → Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Father
perspective_rule: Later Father/Tim interpretation may create new backward relationships to Son events, but it does not retroactively make Tim the subject who was born in 1987 or underwent the 2011 ordeal.

questions: How are Son and Tim related without being identical?
